# CompatibilityBadge

A traffic-light verdict on a move between two tracks (perfect, compatible, possible, clash), as a pill with a mandatory glyph and words.

`SongNodes.CompatibilityBadge` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.CompatibilityBadge level="perfect" label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.CompatibilityBadge" level="perfect" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (CompatibilityBadgeProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `level` * | `"perfect" \| "compatible" \| "possible" \| "clash" \| "unknown"` | Verdict level (from SongNodes.compat, bpmStep or energyStep). |
| `label` * | `string` | Visible words ("+1 key", "−2 BPM", "energy +1"). |
| `outline` | `boolean` | Outline style for tables and rule lists. |
